history.author: fable-cursor
history.criterion: Shot D shows the log arch silhouette in haze like the reference.
history.note: The silhouette is wrong and the haze is wrong. Ours is a rounded lumpy mound roughly as tall as it is wide with a fuzzy top edge, sitting in thin air; the reference is a long flat-topped horizontal trunk roughly 2:1 lying across the path and already about 60 % dissolved into haze at that distance. Its body measures #626769 (cool blue-grey) against the reference's warm #686557. Three featureless orange glow discs 20-21 px wide hang under it with no pod shape, where the reference's two lanterns are small structured points. Through the opening the world is a flat pale wall with no trunks silhouetting in it. The audit flags logArch true and geometry procedural-v1.

history.author: fable-cursor
history.criterion: Shot D shows the log arch silhouette in haze like the reference.
history.note: The arch is in the reference's region (x 0.38-0.62, y 0.27-0.42) and hazed, but its silhouette is a rounded dark mound about as tall as it is wide with a fuzzy top - it reads as a hedge. The reference's is a flat-topped horizontal fallen log about 2.2x wider than tall with pinpoint lanterns. Our two lanterns are bloom orbs about 0.04 of the frame width (5x pod size, survey-2 A1), and beyond the opening is a flat pale wall where the reference shows a deeper plane of trunks (owner's ref-03 mark a).
